name: MNC
recent: MNC 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日召开特别股东大会，股东以 99.9998% 的票数通过削减最多 RM83.00 million 已发行股本的特别决议。公司于 10 月 29 日宣布签署谅解备忘录，并发布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止财务期的合并业绩。
notable: 股东在特别股东大会上通过削减最多 RM83.00 million 已发行股本的特别决议。
公司签署谅解备忘录（内容未提供）。
公司发布截至 2026 年 8 月 31 日止财务期的合并业绩。

ann.title: Consolidated results for the financial period ended 31/08/2026

CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED REDUCTION OF UP TO RM83.00 MILLION OF THE ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL OF MNC PURSUANT TO SECTION 117 OF THE COMPANIES ACT 2016 ("PROPOSED SHARE CAPITAL REDUCTION")

recent_en: MNC held an EGM on 12 November 2026 where shareholders approved a special resolution to reduce up to RM83.00 million of issued share capital with 99.9998% votes in favour. The company announced a memorandum of understanding on 29 October and released consolidated results for the financial period ended 31 August 2026.
notable_en: Shareholders passed a special resolution to reduce up to RM83.00 million of issued share capital at the EGM.
The company entered into a memorandum of understanding (details not provided).
The company released consolidated results for the financial period ended 31 August 2026.
